we should be able to remove this `isSetStateType` (as discussed)
this will keep the logic cleaner (we rely on *just* dataflow instead of a hybrid of data-flow and typing)
This is currently overwriting the operand's derivationEntry. Instead, we want to merge the operand's existing entry with the current instruction's `typeOfValue`
I don't think this is right - if you have a shadowed `Symbol` and reference it, this would incorrectly rewrite those references to refer to the global Symbol not the shadowed one

I think this is correct because referencing a shadowed `Symbol` would be a `LoadGlobal` with `binding.kind === 'ModuleLocal'` or one of the import kinds in HIR, while true references to `globalThis.Symbol` would have `binding.kind === 'Global'`. This is needed because InlineJsxTransform and PropagateEarlyReturns emit `Symbol` references in HIR and those need to be renamed as well.

This assumes that the consequent block doesn't have further nested value blocks "within" it, which would also need to be converted to value blocks. Simplest thing to do is to add a check that the target block ends with a goto to the fallthrough of the outer ternary
this might be overly specific, but i thought i'd err on the side of specificity for now before generalizing
I don't think we need to limit it to just props. If it's a rest spread of a frozen object, we can treat that as shallow mutable
Also it should work for array spreads too: `const [x, ...rest] = useHook()` and for object spread of hook returns, or hook arguments.

This looks right. See my comment elsewhere about updating `mergeValueKinds()` to account for ShallowMutability. The logic there should basically be to treat ShallowMutable like Mutable when it joins with other things (if `Mutable | x => Mutable`, then `ShallowMutable | x => ShallowMutable`). Except `ShallowMutable | Mutable => Mutable`.
